scope: Uninstrumented portable X11 password-to-native-phrase setup, recorded-word confirmation, isolated fresh-profile phrase restore, Settings journal, native balances, receive QR/copy, tab closing and validation feedback; disposable generated and public fixture roots only

steps.name: short-password-feedback
password-mismatch-feedback
Password setup generates and encrypts a random phrase; incorrect recorded words leave setup pending
Pending recovery offers an actionable Send form without enabling payment preparation
Pending Receive guide cancels without opening an unconfirmed address workflow
Native password reauthentication and correct recorded words enable the original wallet receive QR without a file backup
Actual packaged app restores its generated wallet in an empty profile using only app password and recorded phrase
invalid-recovery-phrase-feedback
Known phrase restoration reproduces the independently generated public address without backup files
Wallet table copy icon invokes native verification and copies the full independent public address
Overview table displays its native balance column and an exact ETH quantity or explicit unknown state
Local payment journal exists only in Settings with explicit wallet and asset context
Native Receive displays independently decoded QR pixels and copies the exact address
Confirmed recovery enables Send form without any encrypted-backup prompt
Middle-click closes wallet tab and returns to account table
Restart requires native unlock and preserves confirmed recovery and wallet address
Explicit testnet remains isolated from the restored mainnet profile
Adding deterministic account preserves phrase confirmation and creates its own account tab
Captured logs and persisted profile files contain no tested secret canaries
Native validation and phrase setup produce guidance without IPC handler stack traces or Mesa loader errors

nativeBalanceObservation.scope: Installed Ethereum table native-currency amount and observation metadata visible

recoveryMethod: Native recorded-word confirmation and phrase import; no encrypted backup API or file needed
